text:
WOW WOW WOW!!! Look look LOOK!!!

There’s a man in BLACK clothes and he’s CROUCHING down like a froggy!! He’s playing with the sidewalk!! Is he building something?? Or is he looking for treasure?! 🕵️♂️💎

And there are CONES everywhere!! Orange ones! Red ones! One even has a LID on top like a giant candy jar!! 🍬

Look at the yellow tape!! It says “CAUTION” but I think it means “DON’T TOUCH OR YOU’LL GET IN TROUBLE!!” (But maybe we can peek under it… just a little!) 👀⚠️

There’s a tree right next to him — did he plant flowers around it?? They’re so pretty!! Pink and white!! Like birthday cake sprinkles!! 🌸🌼

Ohhh and there’s a SHOVEL leaning against the tree!! And another one near the cart!! Are they digging for dinosaurs?? 🦖

The ground looks all broken up like a puzzle!! Maybe he’s fixing it!! Or making a secret tunnel!! 🕳️

I wanna help!! Can I wear a hard hat too?? And bring my toy truck?? VROOM VROOM!! 🚛

This is the BEST construction site EVER!! Even better than the park!! (But don’t tell Mommy.)
